user.title: Connect to Alula
user.description: Sign in with your Alula account to control your alarm panel.

data_description.username: The email address you use to sign in to the Alula app.
data_description.panel_id: Optional. Only needed if your account has multiple panels. You can find this in the Alula app under device settings.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. Please check your credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Alula API. Please check your internet connection.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Alula account is already configured.

init.title: Alula options
init.description: Concord 4 has no Night level. Arm Night sends Stay (level 2) with silent exit and no entry delay, and does not use a PIN. armSilent and noEntryDelay are unverified on a Concord 4. Pick the payload to send until a live test shows which one the panel accepts.

data_description.night_arm_variant: forcearm puts the flags on forceArm. arminglevel writes armingLevel with the flags. partition sends partitionArmingLevelChange with no PIN. forcearm_then_arminglevel sends forceArm, waits one second, then armingLevel with the flags. The arminglevel_then_ variants write armingLevel with the flags, wait three seconds for the open-zone protest, then answer it with forceArm, a second armingLevel write, or zoneBypass for each open zone.

force_arm.name: Force arm
force_arm.description: Arm when zones are open, without a PIN. The default is native forceArm. On a Concord 4, bypass leaves the panel disarmed and the keypad on the indirect-bypass prompt. silent, no_entry_delay, and variant are optional. armSilent and noEntryDelay are unverified on a Concord 4. Concord 4 ignores night level 3; use mode home for silent stay.

entity_id.name: Alarm panel
entity_id.description: Alula alarm panel to arm. Optional when only one panel is configured.

method.name: Method
method.description: native (default) writes forceArm. bypass writes zoneBypass and then arms; that does not work on a Concord 4. Ignored when variant is set.

options.bypass: Bypass open zones (does not work on Concord 4)

silent.name: Silent exit
silent.description: Set armSilent. Meant to suppress Concord 4 exit beeps. Unverified on a Concord 4. Default false keeps the existing forceArm payload.

no_entry_delay.name: No entry delay
no_entry_delay.description: Set noEntryDelay. Meant to arm stay with no entry delay. Unverified on a Concord 4. Default false keeps the existing forceArm payload.

variant.name: Payload variant
variant.description: Omit to keep the current method. forcearm puts the flags on forceArm. arminglevel writes armingLevel with the flags. partition sends partitionArmingLevelChange with authType user and no PIN. forcearm_then_arminglevel sends forceArm, waits, then armingLevel with the flags. The arminglevel_then_ variants write armingLevel with the flags, wait three seconds for the open-zone protest, then answer it with forceArm, a second armingLevel write, or zoneBypass for each open zone.

options.arminglevel_then_forcearm: armingLevel with flags, then forceArm to answer the protest
options.arminglevel_then_rearm: armingLevel with flags, sent twice to answer the protest
options.arminglevel_then_zonebypass: armingLevel with flags, then zoneBypass for open zones (works on Concord 4)

bypass_zone.name: Bypass zone
bypass_zone.description: Bypass or restore one zone, without a PIN. Pass the zone sensor, or a 0-based Alula zone index.

entity_id.name: Zone or panel
entity_id.description: Zone binary sensor, or the alarm panel when a zone index is also given.

zone.name: Zone index
zone.description: 0-based Alula zone index, the same number as in the unique id alula_zone_<index>.

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.description: Turn bypass on, or off to restore the zone.
